title.en: Three stages, one at a time

v1t.en: First it remembers, then it finds

v1b.zh: 我们在这里：把你每天说过的、看过的、开过的会变成随叫随到的底座。
v1b.en: This is where we are: what you say, read and sit through each day becomes a base you can call on.

v2b.zh: 下一步：整理出概念与关联，创作开始带引用。
v2b.en: Next: concepts and connections get organized, and writing starts carrying citations.

v3b.zh: 再往后：按你的风格成稿，可授权、可代理，判断权仍在你在。
v3b.en: Later: finished pieces in your style, with delegation and authorization — judgment stays yours.

note.zh: 现在还在内测迭代，所以这一页没有下载按钮——先留个邮箱。
note.en: Still iterating in private beta, which is why there is no download button here — leave an email instead.
